# Young Moore Attorneys

> > A 60+ year Raleigh-based civil law firm with 40+ attorneys serving North Carolina businesses across employment, healthcare, insurance, litigation, and business law.

Young Moore is a full-service North Carolina law firm founded in 1899, offering comprehensive legal services to businesses and institutions. The firm maintains memberships in ALFA International and the International Society of Barristers, reflecting its commitment to high-quality legal representation.

## Key Topics

- Civil Litigation
- Employment Law
- Business Law
- Insurance Law
- Healthcare Law
- North Carolina
- Regulatory Compliance
- Estate Planning
- Transportation & Trucking Law
- Retail & Hospitality
- M&A and Entity Formation
- Insurance Coverage Disputes
- Medical Malpractice Defense
- EEOC Compliance
- Litigation

## Core Practice Areas

- [Practice Areas & Industries](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas): Overview of Young Moore's legal services across business, employment, estate, and litigation
- [Civil Litigation](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas/litigation): Civil litigation services spanning business, medical, employment, and insurance disputes
- [Employment Law](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas/employment-law): Employment law for NC employers: discrimination, wage/hour, compliance, and litigation
- [Business Law](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas/business-law): Business law services: entity formation, M&A, real estate, succession planning
- [Insurance Law](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas/insurance-law): Insurance law: coverage disputes, bad faith claims, defense, and regulatory matters
- [Healthcare Law](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas/health-care): Healthcare law for providers, hospitals, ALFs, and medical malpractice defense
- [Trucking & Transportation Law](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas/trucking): Trucking and transportation litigation: personal injury, cargo, regulatory compliance
- [Retail & Hospitality Litigation](https://www.youngmoorelaw.com/practice-areas/retail-hospitality): Retail and hospitality litigation: premises liability, employment disputes
